trait_description.value: The unicorn has a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows it to communicate with them. The unicorn can use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on animals and to make very simple Requests of them.
A unicorn's Strikes have the effects of a ghost touch property rune.

action_description.value:
(good, magical) 1d10+4 piercing plus 1d6 good and ghost touch
Effects: ghost touch

(agile, magical) 1d8+4 bludgeoning and ghost touch
Effects: ghost touch
The unicorn Strides up to double its Speed in a straight line and then makes a horn Strike. If the unicorn moved at least 20 feet, it deals an additional 2d6 damage on a hit.

description.value:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (4th): The orb sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

description.value:
Your eyes glow as you sense aligned auras. Choose chaotic, evil, good, or lawful. You detect auras of that alignment. You receive no information beyond presence or absence. You can choose not to detect creatures or effects you're aware have that alignment.

Only creatures of 6th level or higher—unless divine spellcasters, undead, or beings from the Outer Sphere—have alignment auras.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (2nd): You learn each aura's location and strength.

targets.value: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature

description.value:
You channel positive energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of positive damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

**1A (somatic)** The spell has a range of touch.

**2A (verbal, somatic)** The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

**3A (material, somatic, verbal)** You disperse positive energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (+1): The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

description.value: You pour healing magic through the target in an attempt to cure one poison afflicting it. Attempt a counteract check against the poison.

You step into a living tree with a trunk big enough for you to fit inside it and instantly teleport to any tree of the same species within 5 miles that also has a sufficiently large trunk.

Once you enter the first tree, you instantly know the rough locations of other sufficiently large trees of the same species within range and can exit from the original tree, if you prefer.

You can't carry extradimensional spaces with you; if you attempt to do so, the spell fails.

higher_level_description.value:
Heightened (6th): The tree you exit can be up to 50 miles away.

Heightened (8th): The tree you exit can be up to 500 miles away.

Heightened (9th): The tree you exit can be anywhere on the same planet.
